author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Fifty-Eight! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Miss the old days of 10mm fantasy games? Miss Chainmail or DBM? Want a reason to paint some of the lovely new Wargames Atlantic plastic sets? Fantasic Battles has you covered with their scale agnostic build-your-own army game of rank and flank combat in 10mm. Let's check it out!

Check out the rulebook in digital  HERE: https://www.wargamevault.com/en/product/334554/fantastic-battles?affiliate_id=210041
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 058 - Fantastic Battles  by Nicholas Wright
